text.en:
The sum of five hundred thousand pesos to be taken from the Excess Income Tax is hereby
appropriated as operating funds of the Task Force on Human Settlements out of any funds in the National
Treasury not otherwise appropriated.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 19th day of September, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
